baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction "do not dispute ... except by that which is best," followed by the exception for those who wrong.
baseline_models.mechanism: The tightly twisted and verbally entangled branches of j-d-l make disputation a handling of already interwoven claims; h-s-n adds beneficent action beyond bare fairness, while withholding a right marks a failure of the reciprocal field.

activation_trace.role: Tight twisting supplies the material image of claims already wound together and needing careful handling.
Interwoven verbal contest supplies the direct speech mechanism rather than a generic topic of disagreement.
Beneficent and well-made action makes the prescribed mode an enacted surplus over mere procedural fairness.
Withholding and confinement from a right marks the point where ordinary reciprocity has broken down.

changed_reading.before: The ayah gives a rule to debate politely, with an unexplained exception.
changed_reading.after: The ayah regulates how to work within an entangled verbal relation: add concretely beneficent conduct, while recognizing that rights-withholding conduct ruptures the normal reciprocal conditions.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "People of the Book," the parallel "sent down to us / sent down to you," and "our God and your God is one."
baseline_models.mechanism: Ahl names a community of belonging, kitab can join parts into a whole, the repeated passive descent preserves two destinations, and divine oneness aligns those distinct receptions in one direction without erasing them.

activation_trace.role: A group constituted by proximity and affiliation makes the addressee a relational community rather than an abstract doctrine.
Joining one thing to another makes scripture a bond-forming assembly as well as a written object.
Delivery from above supplies one sourceward movement with explicitly parallel arrivals to us and to you.
Union in one direction lets distinct communities and deliveries converge without becoming indistinguishable.
Divine oneness without partner supplies the non-negotiable axis of that convergence.

changed_reading.before: The speaker points out that two religions have related scriptures and one deity.
changed_reading.after: The utterance constructs a shared revelatory relation: distinct communities receive parallel deliveries whose joined orientation is the one God.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "Say: we have believed ... and to Him we are muslimun."
baseline_models.mechanism: Spoken belief combines heart-settling trust and assent with handing the matter over to God; the peace branch of s-l-m makes the confession a social posture that resists turning submission into verbal conquest.

activation_trace.role: Audible utterance makes the shared creed a performed response inside the encounter.
Security and trustedness make belief a stabilizing relation rather than only assent to propositions.
Heart-settled assent supplies the confessional content that the utterance claims.
Handing over and relinquishing control makes submission an entrustment of the dispute's final ownership to God.
Peace opposed to war supplies the interpersonal consequence of that entrustment.

changed_reading.before: The final clause is a doctrinal self-identification.
changed_reading.after: The clause performs trusted assent, relinquishes ultimate control to God, and thereby sets a peaceable posture for the exchange.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated exception construction: "except by what is best, except those among them who wrong."
baseline_models.mechanism: The h-s-n mode is attached to conduct, and z-l-m branches picture putting matters out of place and withholding rights; the exception is therefore first behavior-sensitive, not a cancellation based merely on communal identity.

activation_trace.role: A well-done beneficent act defines the default mode as conduct rather than sentiment.
Putting something in the wrong place or time supplies a concrete model of relation-distorting action.
Blocking a due right sharpens wrongdoing into an observable breach rather than a group label.
Affiliated community supplies the larger class from which only a conduct-defined subset is excepted.

changed_reading.before: The exception marks a vaguely hostile subset of the People of the Book.
changed_reading.after: The grammar distinguishes the affiliated community from members whose concrete misplacement or rights-withholding behavior changes the conditions of engagement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah opens by placing the spoken claim of belief into assay and then separating fulfilled truth from lying. The commanded "say, we believe" in 29:46 therefore cannot function as diplomatic wording alone; it claims an allegiance answerable to pressure and action.

activation_trace.role: Audible speech anchors the later change in the commanded confession itself.
Heart-settled assent supplies the content whose integrity is being tested.
Assaying metal or a person makes trial the mechanism that tests whether a spoken belief has substance.
Fulfilling a promise in action defines the positive outcome of the assay.
Contradiction of truth defines the failed outcome and prevents treating confession as self-validating.

structural_cues: 29:2 places the spoken belief claim before the negated expectation of escaping trial.
29:3 follows trial with a truth-versus-lie disclosure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the claim-test-disclosure sequence; I infer that the later commanded confession inherits this accountability. A live alternative is that the opening tests only the speakers' inward faith and does not directly prescribe intercommunal dialogue.

changed_reading.before: "We believe" is a useful common formula in courteous dialogue.
changed_reading.after: "We believe" is a publicly testable pledge whose truth must be borne out under pressure, so common-ground speech is morally costly rather than merely diplomatic.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier parent scene couples commanded goodness with refusal to obey coercive association. It supplies a working precedent for 29:46: preserve a close relation through good action while withholding doctrinal compliance.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent action anchors the prescribed dialogical manner.
Good action toward parents supplies a prior relational instance of the same ethical root.
Driving a person to the limit of hardship makes the disagreement active relational pressure, not mild difference.
Association with God identifies the proposition that cannot be accepted for the sake of harmony.
Obedient yielding supplies the action explicitly refused while goodness remains in force.

structural_cues: 29:8 coordinates goodness to parents with a conditional refusal of obedience.
Both 29:8 and 29:46 use h-s-n in a relation where theological disagreement remains live.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a close-kin case where goodness and noncompliance coexist; I transfer that relational logic to People-of-the-Book disputation. The narrower alternative keeps 29:8 as family ethics only.

changed_reading.before: The best manner may look like softening doctrinal difference to protect the relationship.
changed_reading.after: The best manner is principled relational fidelity: goodness remains obligatory under pressure, but it does not entail compliance in association or surrender of the one-God claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before 29:46, following the recited Book and established prayer produces restraint from the reprehensible, while remembrance keeps God present. The best disputation is thus the next social expression of a worship-trained inhibition, not an isolated debating technique.

activation_trace.role: Entangled verbal contest anchors the social behavior to be regulated.
Beneficent action names the positive mode that worship must produce.
Following in sequence makes recitation an enacted following of revelation rather than information intake.
The specific worship practice supplies the repeated discipline that shapes conduct.
Restraint and checking supply the causal brake on ugly forms of contest.
The reprehensible thing to be repelled includes the recognizable ethical failure the next ayah must avoid.
Keeping God present supplies the governing attention under which the encounter occurs.

structural_cues: 29:45 states an internal restraint mechanism before 29:46 regulates a difficult speech act.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency and prayer's restraining effect; I infer that the upcoming disputation is a test case of that effect. The alternative is that 29:45 offers only a general devotional backdrop.

changed_reading.before: The ayah teaches a freestanding technique for interfaith argument.
changed_reading.after: The ayah tests whether recitation, prayer, and remembrance have actually restrained reprehensible speech and generated beneficent conduct in a charged encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel repeats descent and Book, notes believers among recipients, then names knowing repudiation of clear signs and equates such repudiators with wrongdoers. This turns the exception in 29:46 from an opaque subgroup into a reception posture: active withholding of acknowledged clarity.

activation_trace.role: Parallel delivery anchors the shared revelatory claim whose reception is at issue.
Withholding a right anchors wrongdoing as an active deprivation rather than a communal essence.
The repeated delivery links the sequel's reception scene directly to the focus confession.
Heart-settled assent marks receptive members across the groups named after the focus ayah.
Denial despite knowledge defines the opposing reception mechanism.
Manifest disclosure makes the denied signs clear rather than inaccessible.
A second knowing denial supplies the repeated behavior that the ayah then classifies.
Rights-withholding wrongdoing names the denier's posture and feeds back into the focus exception.

structural_cues: 29:47 begins with a connective and repeats descent, Book, and belief immediately after the focus ayah.
29:49 uses an exception formula parallel to 29:46 and joins j-h-d denial to z-l-m wrongdoing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate lexical recurrence and the denial-wrongdoing equation; I infer that it sharpens the focus exception around active rejection of recognized signs. A live alternative allows the focus wrongdoing to include broader coercion and rights violations as well.

changed_reading.before: "Those among them who wrong" is an undefined or essentially hostile subgroup.
changed_reading.after: The nearby sequence differentiates receptive recipients from those who knowingly suppress manifest signs; the exception is keyed to a culpable reception behavior, without erasing other possible forms of wrongdoing.

context_deltas.mechanism: After demands for additional signs, the sent-down Book being continually followed in recitation is declared sufficient, merciful, and reminding. The focus appeal to what was sent down therefore directs dispute away from spectacle-demand and toward sustained encounter with revelation as mercy.

activation_trace.role: The written object anchors the shared scriptural medium of the focus appeal.
Delivered revelation anchors the object that both communities are told to affirm.
A demanded delivery of further signs supplies the pressure toward spectacle and escalation.
Declaring something sufficient blocks the demand that dialogue continually produce a different proof.
The Book's delivery repeats the focus's revelatory movement and identifies the sufficient gift.
The written revelation supplies the stable shared medium rather than an ad hoc marvel.
Following and succession make recitation an ongoing exposure to the Book.
Tender mercy assigns the sufficient revelation a reparative rather than merely adversarial function.
A reminder supplies the Book's work of reactivation instead of coercive demonstration.

structural_cues: 29:50 voices a demand for sent-down signs; 29:51 answers with the already sent-down, recited Book.
The answer describes that Book by sufficiency, mercy, and reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demand and answer; I infer a dialogical rule that the focus's best mode declines endless spectacle contests and returns to recited revelation. The alternative limits 29:50-51 to prophetic authentication.

changed_reading.before: Affirming what was sent down is a historical proposition shared in debate.
changed_reading.after: Affirming what was sent down means accepting the recited Book as a sufficient merciful encounter, so the best dispute resists being captured by demands for ever-new spectacle.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later questions about creation, cosmic service, and rain elicit the interlocutors' own answer, "God." The focus command to say that both parties' God is one thus expands from assertion into an elicitive method: ask toward an admitted source, then invite reason to hold the implication together.

activation_trace.role: Negotiation in a matter opens the focus command from one-way declaration toward reciprocal verbal inquiry.
Divine oneness supplies the shared conclusion that the later questions elicit.
Questioning and requesting supplies the dialogical operation rather than direct imposition.
Bringing creation into existence supplies a jointly inspectable causal premise.
Directing something to a purpose makes cosmic order part of the premise the interlocutors recognize.
Their audible answer makes common ground something voiced by the interlocutors themselves.
Repeated questioning confirms elicitation as a method rather than an isolated exchange.
Sending down water materially echoes the focus's sending down of revelation.
Delivered water makes descent life-giving and concrete, supporting an analogy with received revelation.
Their answer and the answering command stage a two-sided sequence of speech around the same God.
Reason as a restraint from ignorance supplies the missing step that should bind admission to consequence.

structural_cues: 29:63 couples descent with water and renewed life, echoing the focus's paired descent statements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated elicited admissions; I infer that they model one implementation of disputing by the best means. The addressees in 29:61-63 may be broader than the People of the Book, so the transfer is methodological rather than an identity claim.

changed_reading.before: The shared-God sentence is primarily a declaration delivered to the other community.
changed_reading.after: The declaration can govern an elicitive exchange in which interlocutors voice a shared causal premise themselves and are invited to reason from it toward one-God coherence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ship scene strips devotion to exclusive obedience under danger, then exposes its collapse into association after rescue. Against that cycle, "to Him we are muslimun" claims a durable handing-over that remains after safety returns.

activation_trace.role: Oneness without partner anchors the confession tested by the later relapse.
Handing over the matter to God anchors submission as a continuing disposition.
The vessel moving in water supplies the crisis container that exposes dependency.
Exclusive separation from association supplies the momentary purity of crisis devotion.
Obedience and yielding make that purity a mode of submission, directly comparable to the focus clause.
Association after rescue supplies the reversal that tests whether submission endures.

structural_cues: 29:65 pivots from exclusive devotion during danger to association immediately after deliverance.
The focus confession combines one God with continuing first-person-plural submission.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies crisis purity and post-rescue reversal; I infer that the focus confession distinguishes durable entrustment from emergency recognition. The alternative treats 29:65 only as a critique of a different audience's polytheism.

changed_reading.before: "We submit" states the community's present religious identity.
changed_reading.after: "We submit" claims durable one-God entrustment that must persist across danger and safety, unlike crisis recognition that reverses once control seems restored.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah closes with costly exertion answered by gentle guidance into multiple divine paths and with God's accompaniment of doers of good. The focus superlative "best" becomes an ongoing guided practice, not a fixed rhetorical formula possessed in advance.

activation_trace.role: Beneficent action anchors the ethical quality whose later agents receive divine accompaniment.
Expending capacity under hardship makes the best mode a costly practice rather than effortless civility.
Gentle direction toward path and truth makes right engagement something received through guidance.
Extended traversable paths supply plural routes of faithful movement under one divine direction.
Doers of beneficent action echo the focus root and identify the people accompanied by God.

structural_cues: 29:69 closes the surah by coupling exertion, guidance, plural paths, and muhsinin.
The repeated h-s-n root links the closing ethical agent back to the focus's prescribed manner.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the h-s-n echo and the effort-to-guidance sequence; I infer that 29:69 retrospectively frames 29:46's best mode as guided praxis. The alternative takes muhsinin as a general closing category without a specific dialogical echo.

changed_reading.before: "The best" names a known superior debating style to apply.
changed_reading.after: "The best" names a demanding practice entered with effort and refined by guidance; the speaker does not own it merely by winning an argument.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from ahl affiliation and kitab joining into the spider-house image; it remains anchored in the focus's community, Book, and one-God terms and in 29:41's explicit house mechanism. Render only as a structural analogy, not as a lexical claim that "People of the Book" means a building or that the ayah directly calls their community a web.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "People of the Book" as an affiliated community joined around scripture, oriented by "our God and your God is one."

activation_trace.role: Habitation and familiarity let communal belonging be explored as dwelling within a shared relational space.
Joining parts supplies the constructive bond by which a scriptural community can hold together.
Alignment in one direction supplies a possible load-bearing orientation across distinct members.
The weaving creature supplies a counter-image of elaborate construction whose appearance exceeds its strength.
Shelter and dwelling make the social architecture analogy functional rather than merely decorative.
Weakness of force tests whether a community's bonds can actually bear reliance.

changed_reading.before: "People of the Book" is simply a denominational label for debate partners.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the phrase can cue a built social shelter: scripture joins a community, but its structural strength depends on one-God reliance rather than on intricate bonds that cannot bear weight.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it materializes j-d-l as rope-work and connects it to the plural paths of 29:69. It remains valid as an imagistic mechanism anchored in the focus's j-d-l, joined Book, and one direction, plus the closing guidance sequence. Downstream prose should call it a heuristic image, not the lexical meaning or a claim that all doctrinal paths are equivalent.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The j-d-l command, parallel deliveries of revelation, and one shared divine orientation.

activation_trace.role: Tight rope-twisting supplies the exploratory image of distinct strands handled without snapping or flattening them.
Joining one element to another supports a composite relation between scriptural strands.
Putting each thing in its proper station preserves the distinct placement of the two revelatory receptions.
Union in one direction supplies a common axis without requiring identical provenance.
Gentle direction toward truth supplies movement rather than forced collapse of difference.
Plural traversable paths supply the distinct moving strands of the heuristic.

changed_reading.before: Successful disputation reduces competing formulations to one victorious verbal line.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, the best disputation may braid distinct revelatory trajectories around one divine axis, preserving provenance while seeking guided convergence rather than verbal erasure.

strongest_changes: The confession "we believe" became a testable pledge rather than diplomatic common-ground language.
The immediate 29:45 context made best disputation an observable product of prayer's restraint and remembrance.
29:47-49 sharpened the wrongdoing exception around knowing suppression of manifest signs while preserving receptive members within the addressed community.
29:61-63 supplied an elicitive question-and-admission method for voicing the one-God premise.
29:65 changed submission from identity language into durable entrustment tested across crisis and safety.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted the focus ayah's speech into accountable practice: goodness can coexist with refusal, worship must inhibit ugly contest, revelation is recited mercy rather than demanded spectacle, and shared premises can be elicited without erasing distinct receptions.
remaining_uncertainties: The syntax of the second exception does not by itself specify the alternate manner required toward wrongdoers.
The 29:47-49 sequence strongly sharpens wrongdoing as knowing denial, but does not exclude coercion or rights violations as other instances.
The transfer of the question-and-admission scenes in 29:61-63 to People-of-the-Book dialogue is methodological because their immediate audience may be broader.
The house/web and braided-path readings are intentionally branch-distant analogies and should not be promoted to lexical conclusions.
